newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Jones sells ship to Normar for 2.1mln punts.
newsitem.headline: Jones sells ship to Normar for 2.1mln punts.

text.p: Irish shipping and engineering company Jones Group Plc said on Thursday its unit Dublin Shipping had sold its ship M.V. Rathmoy to a unit of Norway's Normar Holdings for a consideration of 2.1 million Irish pounds.
Jones said in a statement the book value of the vessel, which it acquired in 1983, was 1.4 million punts.
The company said the proceeds of the sale would be used to reduce group borrowings.

"The sale fo the M.V. Rathmoy is part of the group's strategy of upgrading its fleet by the disposal of older vessels and their replacement by newer vessels catering for specialist markets," chief executive Pat Nevin said.
Jones said the building of the M.V. Rathboyne, which is scheduled for delivery in mid-1997 was proceeding, to plan.
